Three steps. No waiting room.

  1. 1

    Tell us what happened.

    Message us on WhatsApp. Tell us what happened and send any photos or documents you have. A Texas attorney will review your case, usually [the same day]. It’s free to find out if we can help.

  2. 2

    We build your case.

    Our system organises your photos, police report and medical records the moment you send them. It requests missing records, builds a timeline of your treatment, totals your bills, drafts letters and tracks every deadline. A trained case team checks the work.

  3. 3

    We pursue your recovery.

    Your attorney spends time where it counts: reviewing your case, advising you and negotiating with the insurance company. For every offer we show what you’d actually keep. You make every settlement decision, with a call from your attorney before you do. If the insurer won’t make a fair offer, we file a lawsuit, and your fee stays 10%.

We win when you win.

The insurance company decides how much to pay based on your case, not on what your lawyer charges. A lower fee doesn’t mean a smaller settlement. It means you keep more of it.

No markup on costs.

No admin fees.

Just someone in your corner.

We charge less because we spend less, not because we do less.

When a firm charges 33–40%, that fee pays for paperwork staff, billboards and expensive offices. None of that makes your case stronger, but it all comes out of your settlement. At 10flat Law technology does the paperwork other firms pay people to do. A trained case team checks the work, and a licensed Texas attorney reviews and approves every important step. No billboards, no marble lobby. Think of it like online banking: it got faster and cheaper because the routine work became automatic.

Questions people ask before they start.

What is the attorney fee?

10% of the amount recovered, calculated after case costs are repaid. It never goes up, even if we go to trial. Most injury firms take 33–40%.

What does it cost to start?

Nothing. If there is no recovery, you owe no fee and no case costs. There is no markup on case costs and no admin fees. Medical bills and liens are paid from your recovery the same way at any firm.

Does the fee go up if my case goes to trial?

No. Our fee stays 10% whether the case settles early or goes all the way to trial. At most firms the percentage rises from 33% to 40% once a lawsuit is filed.

Does a lower fee mean a smaller settlement?

No. The insurance company decides how much to pay based on your injuries, your medical bills, the facts and the insurance coverage, not on what your lawyer charges. What the fee changes is how much of the settlement you keep.

Which cases qualify?

Injury cases such as car accidents and medical or dental injury claims. A licensed Texas attorney reviews every request, usually [the same day], and may accept or decline it. It’s free to find out if we can help.
